page.notes: The right margin notes are small italic references. Note a and note b are keyed to the text by letter marks; the "c" mark after the Greek phrase keys the note Lib. 2. c. 14. The large Q at the foot is a decorative initial, probably the start of the next page; the Greek catchword λεις is read from the right side. Some Greek words are uncertain and may contain errors.
